description: This Java source file defines the CheckVoiceData class, an Android Activity that checks the presence of voice data for specified languages, particularly in a Text-to-Speech (TTS) engine context. It verifies support for languages, checks if their data is installed (via assets), and returns the results to the calling component.

classes.name: CheckVoiceData
classes.description: An Android Activity that checks for the presence of voice data corresponding to specific languages and reports the availability status.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that initializes the check for voice data support based on intent extras, and determines whether required voice data is available.

methods.name: getCheckVoiceDataFor
methods.description: Extracts a list of language codes for which voice data should be checked, based on intent extras.

methods.name: isLanguageSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given language code is supported based on a predefined list of supported language codes.

methods.name: isDataInstalled
methods.description: Verifies if the voice data for the specified language is present within the app's assets by attempting to open a corresponding asset file.
